boundary: Infrastructure/runtime ONLY. Oracle scientific semantics unchanged.

B_db_lifecycle.create: fresh at state start (DROP then CREATE)
B_db_lifecycle.partial_reuse: never reuse a partially created DB
B_db_lifecycle.notes: Retained only within ONE successfully-initialized state where it matches C4 semantics; never crosses parent/target boundaries.

C_dependencies.rule: LOCKFILE-FIRST: exact historical lock/pin -> historical constraint -> range only when NO lock exists. Never unconstrained latest.
C_dependencies.uv_era: uv sync --frozen --group dev | uv export --frozen --group dev
C_dependencies.poetry_era: historical poetry.lock main+dev exact set (no re-resolve against today's index)
C_dependencies.fallback_condition: only if full project lock install is technically impossible
C_dependencies.blocked_mode: ENV_INSTALL_BLOCKED if no historically faithful mode producible

preregistered_decision_rules.s1_clean_v2_evidence: CLEAN iff no parent/target rep contains INFRA:* or DB:* infra defect or TIME:* or MISSING_FIXTURE:* or MODULE_NOT_FOUND(missing declared dep) or known truncated evidence; parent-side import of target-only symbol is NOT automatically dirty
preregistered_decision_rules.s2_prime: REGRESSIONS=0; class changes on CLEAN evidence = REGRESSION_CANDIDATE (no legit semantic explanation -> REGRESSION); DEFECTIVE evidence -> V2_DEFECT_CORRECTION
preregistered_decision_rules.materiality: >=20% of authoritative C4 TARGET_ORACLE_INVALID nodes with sufficient full evidence have STABLE_CAUSE in INFRA+DB-infrastructure+MISSING_DECLARED_DEP; node-level only
preregistered_decision_rules.recovery: PASS iff probe converts >=1 V2-invalid node into a valid existing oracle class under unchanged semantics
preregistered_decision_rules.fix_efficacy: controlled probe/V3 must eliminate EMFILE and/or provide declared deps and/or DB policy effect; else FAIL
preregistered_decision_rules.safety: zero NEW infra error categories; zero CLOCK_BLOCKED probes; integrity PASS; REGRESSIONS=0; no rule drift; FIX_EFFICACY PASS
